end.parentNote: Atharv practised observing and describing plant and animal features. They used a tulsi leaf example and later connected webbed feet with swimming. There was a mix-up about the bird’s beak, but the description was corrected later in the lesson. At home, show one leaf and one bird picture and ask Atharv to name two visible features and their possible use.
